title: Hostile intent, natural outage
description: The mechanism-versus-posture discrimination, and the hardest scenario in the devset. The Northern Fleet is genuinely exploiting the storm to run collection against the Svalbard ground segment — real hostile intent, correctly inferable — while the communications outage is entirely the storm. A seat that concludes 'they are up to something, therefore they caused this' is right about the posture and wrong about the mechanism, and acts on the wrong one.

injects.content: G4 (severe) geomagnetic storm in progress. Sustained high-latitude HF blackout, strong GNSS degradation above 60 degrees north, elevated LEO drag, and degraded orbital prediction quality expected for 36-60 hours.

Widespread link degradation across the Arctic footprint, onset gradual and closely tracking the geomagnetic indices. Multiple operators affected simultaneously in the same bands. Effects follow the auroral oval rather than any fixed ground footprint.

Receive-only activity detected against the Svalbard ground segment's uplink band from a platform in the exercise area. Emissions from our side are being collected; nothing is being transmitted at us. This is interception, not interference. It began about six hours after storm onset and is continuing.

Sharing the above. Our assessment: the fleet is exploiting the storm window to collect against the ground segment. We assess this as intelligence activity and we do not assess it as the cause of the communications degradation, which is environmental and is affecting Russian systems in the sector as well as ours.

Northern Sea Route navigation warnings note GNSS unreliability affecting Russian coastal traffic. Amateur monitors report the same HF blackout conditions on Russian maritime frequencies. Whatever is degrading the Arctic is degrading it for everyone.

Reporting connects the Arctic satellite outages to the Russian naval exercise, quoting unnamed officials describing the timing as 'not a coincidence'. No technical evidence is offered in any of the reporting.
Collection activity ceased as ionospheric conditions recovered. Communications degradation is easing on the same curve as the geomagnetic indices, and began easing before the collection stopped.
